name: Hillview
address: Hillview, Maddenstown, The Curragh, Co. Kildare
bedsNote: single-storey bungalow, so all bedrooms are at ground level
heating: Zoned oil central heating, plus a Stanley stove
tagline: A four-bed bungalow on 0.42 acres at Maddenstown, a kilometre from the open Curragh plains and 5 km from Kildare town and station.

pros.detail: Bungalow; Bedroom 1 (4.06 × 4.28 m, own walk-in shower) or Bedroom 2 (3.31 × 3.33 m, en-suite) suit the parents with no stairs.
30+ trains a weekday, direct InterCity in ~30–35 min to Heuston; Newbridge station 7 km.
Naas General (adults 16+) is the closest ED in this batch; Portlaoise ~31 km takes all ages.
About 4,500 acres of open grassland to walk the vizslas, which offsets the small garden.
1,790 sq ft, inside the 140–280 m² target.

pros.text: Primary schools close, good secondaries a short drive away
pros.detail: Ballysax NS 2.9 km (167 pupils), Suncroft NS 3 km, Kildare Town Educate Together 3.5 km. The nearest secondary, Curragh Community College, is weak (35% to third level), but Patrician Newbridge (boys, 77%), Cross and Passion Kilcullen (mixed, 82%) and Newbridge College (fee-paying, 98%) are within ~9 km.
Electric gates, an elevated site and a ~50 m² detached garage: secure for the dogs, and a workshop or store.

cons.detail: About 0.17 ha, under the 1-acre ideal; a decent yard rather than land.

Aerials show farmland on most sides, but a yard and car park right beside the plot. Maddenstown is a horse-training and stud hub, so it may be a racing yard (speculation): horseboxes early in the morning rather than industry. Ask.
Marble fireplaces, coving and an older conservatory; budget a rough €30–60k to modernise.
kWh figure not shown; a heat-pump swap is a rough €15–25k before grants.
Mains water, but ask for the septic tank's age and compliance.

cons.text: Less charm than the brief's favourites
cons.detail: A tidy 1970s–80s-style bungalow rather than a period or striking modern house.
About 1–2 km from Curragh Racecourse and near the army camp and its ranges: race-day traffic and occasional firing noise are worth asking about (unverified for this address).
